parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches. <short pause> Psalm sixty-three, verse six.

Father, as I lie here in the quiet, my thoughts turn to You. <short pause> Through the long watches of the night, You are with me. <short pause> I remember who You are and what You have done, and my heart is at peace. <short pause> Amen.
